code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    best=None;bn=0
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=grid[i][j]
            if c and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True;n=0
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft();n+=1
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and not seen[a][b] and grid[a][b]==c:
                            seen[a][b]=True;q.append((a,b))
                if n>bn:bn=n;best=c
    return [[best]*3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
